bio.text: Lauri Shillings won the Libertarian Party of Indiana's nomination for secretary of state at its state convention in Fort Wayne in March 2026.
She lives in Carmel, was the Libertarian candidate for Indiana's 5th Congressional District in 2024, and has been the party's Hamilton County chair since 2021.
She is creative director in the University of Indianapolis' marketing office.

sources.title: Indiana Libertarians nominate Lauri Shillings for secretary of state
